name: participant_id
label: Participant ID

name: session_id
label: Session ID

name: wk
label: Week number starting from first day of 21 day protocol period

name: day
label: Day number starting from first day of 21 day protocol period

name: dt
label: Date of the night (PM portion of sleep period) of sleep being considered

name: dt_day
label: Day of the week

name: dt_wknd
label: Is this day a weekend (Saturday or Sunday)

name: dtt_start_bed
label: First minute that the participant was identified as being in-bed (but not necessarily asleep) during main sleep period

name: dtt_end_bed
label: First minute that the participant was identified as being out-bed (but may have woken up prior to this) during main sleep period

name: dtt_start_slp
label: First minute that the participant was identified as being asleep during main sleep period

name: dtt_end_slp
label: First minute that the participant was identified as being awake during main sleep period

name: min_total_slp
label: Total time in sleep (including staged and wake periods) during main sleep period

name: min_asleep_slp
label: Minutes identified as "asleep" using classic (60 second) during main sleep period

name: min_restless_slp
label: Minutes identified as "restless" using classic (60 second) during main sleep period

name: min_light_slp
label: Total number of minutes identified as being in light sleep stage during main sleep period

name: min_deep_slp
label: Total number of minutes identified as being in deep sleep stage during the main sleep period

name: min_rem_slp
label: Total number of minutes identified as being in REM sleep stage during the main sleep period

name: min_nap_slp
label: All sleep minutes, regardless of staging during non-main sleep period(s)

name: min_wake
label: Total number of minutes identified as being awake during the sleep window (all wake/awake)

name: min_waso
label: Total number of minutes identified as being awake during the sleep window (excludes first and final awakening)

name: n_waso
label: Total number of unique awakenings during the sleep period (excludes first and final awakening)

name: hrate_awake_slp
label: Mean heart rate during minutes that were classified as wake or awake  during the main sleep window

name: hrate_restless_slp
label: Mean heart rate during minutes that were classified as restless during the main sleep window

name: hrate_asleep_slp
label: Mean heart rate during minutes that were classified as asleep during the main sleep window

name: hrate_light_slp
label: Mean heart rate during minutes that were classified as light sleep stage  during the main sleep window

name: hrate_deep_slp
label: Mean heart rate during minutes that were classified as deep sleep stage  during the main sleep window

name: hrate_rem_slp
label: Mean heart rate during minutes that were classified as REM sleep stage  during the main sleep window

name: hrate_nap_slp
label: Mean heart rate during minutes outside the main sleep window regardless of sleep stage classification

name: hrate_rest_fitb
label: Number resting heart rate for the day provided by Fitbit

name: excl_min_total_slp
label: Number of minutes from the first minute of sleep on the day in question to the first minute of awake on the next day excluded for any reason (these data cross midnight)

name: excl_min_lowhrate_slp
label: Number of minutes from the first minute of sleep on the day in question to the first minute of awake on the next day excluded because heart rate was lower than 50 bpm (these data cross midnight)

name: excl_min_nohrate_slp
label: Number of minutes from the first minute of sleep on the day in question to the first minute of awake on the next day excluded because there was no heart rate value for the given minute (these data cross midnight)

name: excl_min_repeathrate_slp
label: Number of minutes from the first minute of sleep on the day in question to the first minute of awake on the next day excluded because there were identical heart rate values repeated for 10+ instances (these data cross midnight)

name: min_extra_nohrate_slp
label: Number of sleep minutes excluded due to possible data capture errors

name: qc_300min
label: Does this day have >299 minutes of sleep wear (based on 60 second data) after all exclusions (see Wing et al., 2022)

name: flg_slp
label: Flags days where device-recorded sleep is immediately followed by ≥30 minutes of missing or repeated heart rate data, suggesting inconsistent or unreliable sensor measurement.

name: flg_any
label: Are there any minutes with valid activity data in this day
